finding.summary: 依赖存在但未被该判定消费，属未接线而非实现
finding.condition: block_size is not None and block_size != 1

paper.quote: A specialization hint could also specify the block size equal to the tensor’s shape (i.e., one block covers the whole tensor).

analysis.tier_note: the probes confirm what the Finding says
analysis.reasoning: The shown code branches only on block_size None, 1, or else; it never compares block_size to the tensor shape. Any other value, including a shape-sized block, is routed to the generic blocksparse template. Thus the paper’s whole-tensor block-size hint is not explicitly wired as a specialization, matching the not_implemented finding.
analysis.would_confirm: A static search or unit test that sets block_size to the tensor shape and checks whether a dedicated whole-tensor specialization is selected would settle it.
